Justin continued his trend of second spots in the steeplechase as Shaftesbury pulled a flanker by switching John Sherban for the 5000 to the 'chase.

The Shaftesbury Barnet team manager judged things just right, for John Sherban, on the penultimate leg, set the fastest long stage time of the day in turning a 30 second deficit into a 55 second lead.
Fastest long stage (4m 1448y) K.Cullen (Chelmsford) 22:14. Short stage (2m 1260y) J.Sherban Shaftesbury B) 12:33.

Forty-five year-old 'toughie' Pete Gilbey set out with Shaftesbury's international John Sherban on his shoulder, had him race past within seconds, but 14 minutes later came back home with the Shaftesbury man nowhere to be seen (he'd pulled a muscle).
